facts.claim: The town has become a rising and busy centre since the railway arrived in 1889 and the taluq headquarters was located there.
facts.quote: Since the advent of the railway in 1889, and the location here of the taluq head-quarters, it has developed into a rising and busy centre.

facts.claim: The town has an evil reputation as the haunt of robbers who infested the high road.
facts.quote: it has an evil reputation as the haunt of robbers who infested the high road.

facts.claim: The staff occupying the railway quarters accounts for the considerable number of Christians in the population.
facts.quote: the staff occupying the railway quarters accounts for the considerable number of Christians in the population.
